composition: The long brick convent range and the mill pond · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Esrum Abbey is the long red-brick convent range that remains, with a projecting mid-bay, a tall brick gable dormer, a high roof of red tiles, and a mill pond in front. The grounds are empty. It is light drizzle, about 13.3°C. The wind is light, about 12.6 km/h. Light drizzle is falling. The cloud deck hides the moon. It is not a palace, and the church is gone.
